channel.title: Jacob + Madison Faculty Job Matches
channel.description: Broad assistant-professor and assistant-eligible open-rank matches for the Fall 2027 cycle from six approved university sources. Unstated start dates are flagged for verification.

item.title: Stanford University — Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor — Pharmacoepidemiology
item.description: Real-world evidence search emphasizing large healthcare databases, causal inference, comparative effectiveness, and quantitative methods. Strongest fit: Jacob.

item.title: Stanford University — Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor — Surgery Policy Improvement Research & Education
item.description: AI-enabled surgical policy and outcomes search focused on decision-making, patient outcomes, implementation, and multidisciplinary collaboration. Strong fit for Jacob and Madison.

item.title: Stanford University — Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor of Health Policy (Health Economist)
item.description: Health economics search spanning health systems, delivery, payment, digital health, AI, population health, and related policy areas. Strongest fit: Jacob.

item.title: Stanford University — Open Rank Faculty — Education in a Rapidly Changing World
item.description: Broad social-science search focused on education amid inequality, polarization, technological innovation, and societal change. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Stanford University — Assistant Professor in Communication — Media and Politics
item.description: Media-and-politics search welcoming data and information science, political economy, polarization, and computational or experimental methods. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: University of California, Berkeley — Assistant Professor — Open Field — Demography
item.description: Open-field search naming computational demography, economic demography, health and aging, migration, and population dynamics. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: University of California, Berkeley — Assistant Professor — Quantitative Marketing
item.description: Quantitative marketing search emphasizing analytics, industrial organization, digital marketing, and empirical or analytical methods. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: University of California, Berkeley — Assistant Professor — Organizations, Entrepreneurship and Innovation
item.description: Search for research on entrepreneurship or innovation, especially mechanisms shaping behavior, organizations, performance, and inequality. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: University of California, Berkeley — Assistant Professor — Open Field — Sociology
item.description: Open-field sociology search with no restriction on specialization. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Stanford University — Open Field, Open Rank Faculty Position in Political Science
item.description: Open-field political-science search. Assistant-level applications are due November 1; review begins September 1. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: University of California, Berkeley — Assistant Professor — American Politics or Public Law
item.description: Political-science search with preference for scholars working in American politics or public law. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: University of California, Berkeley — Assistant Professor — Finance
item.description: Broad finance search covering banking, credit, mortgages, insurance, regulation, financial markets, and empirical or theoretical work. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: University of California, Los Angeles — Tenure-Track Assistant Professor of Law — Open Field
item.description: Entry-level, open-field law search accepting JD, PhD, or equivalent candidates for a July 2027 appointment. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: University of Southern California — Research Assistant Professor of Health Policy & Management
item.description: Schaeffer-based health-policy and health-economics role covering healthcare value, access, quality, spending, delivery, insurance, and medical innovation. Strongest fit: Jacob.

item.title: University of Southern California — Assistant Professor — Health Behavior Data Analytics
item.description: Computational public-health search using large digital and behavioral data, experiments or quasi-experiments, networks, NLP, computer vision, and machine learning. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Northwestern University — Faculty Positions in Industrial Engineering & Management Sciences — 2 Positions
item.description: Two tenure-line searches spanning optimization, AI and machine learning, data-driven decision-making, financial engineering, and healthcare operations. Strong fit for Jacob and Madison.

item.title: Northwestern University — Assistant or Untenured Associate Professor — AI and Innovation
item.description: Kellogg-wide search for scholars studying how AI changes innovation, knowledge production, scientific discovery, organizational decisions, or networks. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Stanford University — Open Rank Faculty Position — Comparative Politics
item.description: Open-rank comparative-politics search accepting assistant-level candidates for a September 2027 appointment. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: University of California, Berkeley — Assistant Professor - Civil Rights - School of Law
item.description: Assistant Professor - Civil Rights - School of Law. This position will advance the work of the Civil Rights Endowment, which was established to honor the life and legacy of Judge Thelton Henderson, whose career was dedicated to public service and the advancement of equal justice under the law. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Northwestern University — Open Rank Faculty Position in AI Innovation
item.description: To fill this position we are seeking a scholar studying how AI reshapes innovation, knowledge production, scientific discovery, organizational decision-making, or networks. Strongest fit: Madison.
